title: Shopify debuts Canvas, a way to build online stores by chatting with AI | TechCrunch
summary: To make this work, Shopify gave Sidekick the ability to work directly with the theme’s files and simplified the theme architecture so the store’s structure, logic, and design would be easier for Sidekick to understand and change.
